atoms.text:
If you love shopping, you should visit Dubai, since it is known for its shopping centres. For what reason? Dubai has over 96 shopping centres. Among them are the largest and most impressive shopping centres in the world.

One of the shopping centres that you shouldn't miss is the Dubai Mall, because it is the largest shopping centre in Dubai. It is 350,000 square metres big and home to more than 1,200 shops, including many luxury brands. Moreover, it houses the Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo, a cinema and an ice skating rink.

In addition to the shopping centres, you can also visit traditional markets in Dubai. One of them is the Dubai Spice Souk and another is the Dubai Gold Souk. Some of the shops at the markets are decades old, which is why they offer a unique insight into the city's culture and history.

To sum up, one can say that Dubai is a shopper's dream destination. You can go shopping at modern shopping centres, but also at more traditional markets. In other words, there is something for everybody.
